  FROM reports_to r
  JOIN chain c ON r.person = c.manager
)

  WHERE instr(c.path, r.manager) = 0
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chain WHERE m = 'dana') THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS answer,
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT path FROM chain WHERE m = 'dana' ORDER BY lvl LIMIT 1),
